cards.front: What are the true boundaries for the class 10-14 if data is rounded to the nearest whole number?
In a histogram, what does the area of each bar represent?
cards.back: Frequency

cards.front: What is the formula for frequency density?
cards.back: $$$\frac{\text{frequency}}{\text{class width}}$$

cards.front: In a histogram, the vertical axis represents [ ___ ], not frequency.
cards.back: In a histogram, the vertical axis represents frequency density, not frequency.

cards.front: How do you calculate the horizontal scale on a drawn histogram (cm per unit)?
cards.back: $$$\frac{\text{drawn width in cm}}{\text{true class width}}$$

cards.front: Why are histogram height and width scales calculated independently?
cards.back: Frequency is represented by area, so height must represent frequency density specifically.

cards.front: The interquartile range (IQR) represents the spread of the middle [ ___ ] of the data.
cards.back: The interquartile range (IQR) represents the spread of the middle 50% of the data.

cards.front: How do you calculate the IQR from quartiles?
What is the lower fence formula for identifying outliers?
cards.back: $$Q_1 - 1.5 \times \text{IQR}$

cards.front: What is the upper fence formula for identifying outliers?
cards.back: $$Q_3 + 1.5 \times \text{IQR}$

cards.front: Where do the whiskers stop on a box plot if outliers are present?
cards.back: At the smallest and largest non-outlier values.

cards.front: On a box plot, outliers are typically plotted separately using [ ___ ].
cards.back: On a box plot, outliers are typically plotted separately using crosses.

cards.front: List three features to compare when describing two distributions using box plots.
cards.back: Location (compare medians)Spread (compare IQRs or ranges)Outliers (mention any in context)

cards.front: When are the median and IQR preferred over the mean and standard deviation?
cards.back: When data are skewed or contain outliers.

cards.front: What is the formula for standard deviation using summary statistics?
cards.back: $$$\sqrt{\frac{\sum x^2}{n} - \bar{x}^2}$$

cards.front: A variable is measured to the nearest whole number. The class 11-18 has true boundaries of [ ___ ] and 18.5.
cards.back: A variable is measured to the nearest whole number. The class 11-18 has true boundaries of 10.5 and 18.5.

cards.front: A variable is measured to the nearest whole number. The class 11-18 has true boundaries of 10.5 and [ ___ ].
cards.back: A variable is measured to the nearest whole number. The class 11-18 has true boundaries of 10.5 and 18.5.

cards.front: When finding quartiles from an odd number of data values, do not include the [ ___ ] in either half for calculation.
cards.back: When finding quartiles from an odd number of data values, do not include the median in either half for calculation.

cards.front: How do you estimate probability from a histogram if the total frequency is known?
cards.back: $$$\frac{\text{area of required section}}{\text{total area}} \times \text{total frequency}$$ (then divide by total frequency) or simply the ratio of areas.

cards.front: Mean and standard deviation are most useful when data are [ ___ ] and have no major outliers.
cards.back: Mean and standard deviation are most useful when data are symmetrical and have no major outliers.
